scientific_integrity: A symbolic all-direction proof is supplied; a standalone exact combinatorial checker and numerical tests are included as supporting checks, not as substitutes for proof. Public sources are credited; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for Haar-uniform central plane orientations of the standard rhombic dodecahedron only; boundary normal sets have measure zero. No claims for random offsets, noisy estimates or affine deformations. Historical priority provisional due to inaccessible relevant 2015 book chapter.
title: Exact central-section hexagon and octagon probabilities for the rhombic dodecahedron
